verdict.rationale: The evidence documents a REST v3 API, a Postman collection, per-language sample code in the API reference, embeddable UI Elements widgets, and a docs MCP server. None of these is an official language SDK or client library to build against. Sample snippets and Postman collections are adjacent developer aids, and Elements are embedded UI widgets rather than a programmatic SDK.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
